focus.name: interaction-spawn-type11-12-semantic
focus.purpose: Promote the adjacent Type-0x11 palette and Type-0x12 presentation interaction handlers to stable creation identities while retaining selector-qualified historical names.

handlers.name: InteractionSpawn_CreateType12WithPresentation_4D
handlers.audio: prepared command 0x32 when SCENE_TRANSITION_EVENT is active

contracts: Selector 0x1F creates the exact Type-0x11 collision-response template through LevelObjectSpawnEntry and uploads palette band 2 from ROM 0x001295F2 only after successful allocation.

Selector 0x4D creates the exact Type-0x12 interaction-response template through LevelObjectSpawnEntry, uploads palette band 2 from ROM 0x001295D2, sets presentation flag 0x00FFF123 after allocation, and conditionally queues prepared audio command 0x32.
Both handlers retain their exact 20-byte actor-template contracts and direct helper/side-effect behavior.
limitations: The names identify exact creation and presentation contracts, not user-facing object or scene roles.
The upstream lifecycle of the palette, presentation, and audio gates remains unresolved.
